*** FTSE CAVEAT — THIRD MORNING RUNNING ***
.FTSE returned the previous session's close (10,541.69, stamped 2026-10-06) on all three reads at 07:54,
08:01 and 08:09 BST, i.e. after the London open. The same happened on 5 and 6 October. Three mornings in
a row is no longer a one-off: the CNBC .FTSE feed lags the first half-hour of the London session. The
published FTSE level is therefore Tuesday's close, +0.42% on Monday, and the drivers say so explicitly.
ACTION: find a second FTSE provider before the next morning edition.

GILT: Tuesday's close reads 5.3775% in the prev field, consistent with the 5.3836 published at 08:06
yesterday morning. Published 5.43 +0.06. Trading Economics independently shows UK 10Y at 5.42, up 0.039
on the day, stamped Oct/07 — same level to two decimals, same direction, slightly smaller move.
DISCREPANCY NOTED: the Guardian business live blog at 07:51 BST said gilts were "down slightly to 5.37%".
That matches Tuesday's close, not a Wednesday print, and is contradicted by two independent live reads.
Not used; the sources block records that it was set aside and why.
